description:
From: Make Distiller Fast. User-approved 2026-11-25.

A rarely taken runtime call (a raise arm, fz_heap_room, fz_panic and similar) moves into one shared out-of-line stub per cold call kind. The cold arm tail-calls the stub with its live values as arguments, as #887 did for the yield path. PreserveAll cannot be used, because the Cranelift verifier forbids return values with it. For a raise arm the stub never returns; that is the simplest instance and the first step.

Cases, in order:
1. The overflow raise arm of integer `+` (blocks fz-yh5.1's fz-side part, which the user held behind this ticket). Evidence (Callables, fz-yh5.1 "State 2026-11-24", scratch yh51/why/): the inlined `+` carries the whole raise path, about 236 bytes of fz_heap_room, fz_struct_store_ref and fz_panic. Two values live across those calls force x19/x20 saves on every path, including the path that never overflows. The same is paid inside fz_op_add_ii and at every in-place delivered call.
2. fz_heap_room: 48 of 84 JSON functions save registers for it after #887.
3. fz_panic: 18 functions. fz_binary_concat: 7. fz_share_list_spine: 6. fz_alloc_binview_from_static: 5.
4. The call-step move ledger: a call step moves no value twice.

Page: 4JyVHKjbDBw1bzRDu17PZd, section 8.

Acceptance:
- A function whose only calls are on a raise arm has no callee-saved register saves in its prologue. Shown for `+` on known integers (fz_op_add_ii and one in-place site) in the prologue table.
- Overflow still raises ArithmeticError on all three paths.
- The bench is judged on the instruction-count pass rule.

Order: after GC's fz-9x7.41.7, as agreed. fz-yh5.1 depends on this ticket.
title: A rarely taken runtime call costs the function nothing, and a call step moves no value twice
